academy.title: Messages
academy.description: Send an email and/or an in-app notification to your learners or staff. Every message is previewed and confirmed before it is sent.

platform.description: Send an email and/or an in-app notification to organization and academy owners. Broadcasts never count against an academy’s monthly email allowance.

composer.title: New message
composer.channelRequired: Choose at least one way to send.
composer.subject: Subject
composer.previewFirst: Preview the recipients first — you will see exactly who receives this before anything is sent.

editor.linkInvalid: Use a full https:// address or a mailto: link.

academy.learnersHelp: Everyone enrolled in this academy, except blocked or pending learners.
academy.coursesHelp: Active learners enrolled in, or who completed, the courses you choose.
academy.staffHelp: Active team members with the roles you choose.
academy.noCourses: This academy has no courses yet.

platform.org_ownersHelp: The owner of every active organization.
platform.academy_owners: Academy owners by plan or status
platform.academy_ownersHelp: Owners of academies on the plans and subscription statuses you choose.
platform.academy_owners_adminsHelp: Every active academy owner and administrator.
platform.organizationHelp: That organization’s members and its academies’ owners and administrators.
platform.anyIfNone: Leave all unticked to include every one.

preview.title: Who will receive this
preview.notEmailed: Not emailed (they still get the in-app notification if it is on):

preview.overQuotaTitle: Not enough emails left this month

confirm.subject: Subject:

confirm.largeAudience: I understand this message goes to {{formatted}} people.

quota.usage: {{used}} of {{limit}} emails used this month, resets {{date}}
quota.explainer: Each email queued from Messages counts once. In-app notifications are free. Emails that fail before reaching the email provider are given back.

history.emptyDescription: Messages you send appear here with their delivery progress.
